description: This Java class defines a data container for calendar-related data within the Fineract platform. It includes fields for calendar properties such as dates, recurrence, reminders, and options, along with static factory methods to create instances with default or specific configurations, and utility methods for date comparisons and validation.

classes.name: CalendarData
classes.description: A data transfer object representing calendar entries, supporting various configurations, recurrence, reminders, options, and validation utilities.

methods.name: importInstanceNoRepeatsOnDay
methods.description: Creates an instance of CalendarData for import with no repeats on specific days.

methods.name: importInstanceWithRepeatsOnDay
methods.description: Creates an instance of CalendarData for import with repeats on specific days.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Creates a complete CalendarData instance with all properties specified.

methods.name: withRecurringDates
methods.description: Returns a new CalendarData instance with specified recurring dates, next dates, and recent meeting date.

methods.name: withRecentEligibleMeetingDate
methods.description: Returns a new CalendarData instance with an updated recent eligible meeting date.

methods.name: sensibleDefaultsForNewCalendarCreation
methods.description: Provides a CalendarData object with default initial values for creating a new calendar.

methods.name: withTemplateOptions
methods.description: Returns a CalendarData instance populated with given template options.

methods.name: isStartDateBeforeOrEqual
methods.description: Checks if the start date is before or equal to a given date.

methods.name: isEndDateAfterOrEqual
methods.description: Checks if the end date is after or equal to a given date.

methods.name: isBetweenStartAndEndDate
methods.description: Checks if a date falls within the start and end date range.

methods.name: isValidRecurringDate
methods.description: Validates if a date is valid for recurrence based on the recurrence rules.
